headlines.title: Can ARM's 13% Contract Value Growth Sustain Momentum in Q2?
headlines.summary: Arm Holdings' annualized contract value rose 13% to $1.73 billion, signaling licensing momentum ahead of fiscal Q2 earnings.

headlines.title: Why Arm Holdings Stock Was Falling Today
headlines.summary: A hot CPI report hit tech stocks hard.

headlines.title: ARM Stock Is Up 123% This Year. Is It Too Late to Get In?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysArm stock has gained 123% since early January to close at $255 on October 13, but it sits 28% below its June 30 close of $355. On the July 29 earnings call, CEO Rene Haas said demand for the Arm AGI CPU now exceeds $2B.

headlines.title: How Qualcomm’s Mixed Jury Verdict With Arm Could Inform the Long-Term Thesis for QCOM Investors
headlines.summary: • Earlier this month, a federal jury in Delaware delivered a mixed verdict in Qualcomm’s case against Arm, finding that Arm breached Qualcomm’s Architectural License Agreement and interfered with its business relationship with Meta Platforms, while awarding Qualcomm US$2 in nominal damages. Arm said the jury found for it on four other claims.

headlines.title: Arm vs. Sandisk: Which Tech Stock Is a Better Buy in October?
headlines.summary: Arm commands a 107x forward P/E while Sandisk trades at just 6.7x, a valuation gap that reveals starkly different growth expectations in semiconductor investing.

description: Arm Holdings plc researches, develops, licenses, and markets central processing unit (CPU) intellectual property (IP), graphics processing unit IP, systems IP, compute subsystems (CSS), and associated software, tools and related services. The company provides a product portfolio, including CPU IP, GPU and neural processing unit (NPU) accelerators, system IP such as interconnects, compute platform products including pre-integrated CSSs, and development tools and software. The company serves semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), cloud service providers (CSPs), and organizations developing chips for end markets such as smartphones, consumer electronics, industrial IoT, embedded systems, cloud data centers, networking, automotive, and robotics. It provides its products and services in the United States, China, Japan, Taiwan, Korea, and internationally. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cambridge, United Kingdom. Arm Holdings plc operates as a subsidiary of SoftBank Group Corp.
